item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now affecting the coast of southern China will weaken tomorrow, while an area of low pressure will affect the coast of western Guangdong. With the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, showers will ease off and it will be brighter over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. High temperatures will also trigger showers over inland areas. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. The northeast monsoon will affect southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will be slightly cooler and relatively dry over the region midweek next week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific to the south of Japan will bring unsettled weather to the region in the next couple of days.
